"""Extract fixed endpoint metrics for the human quality review, without inference."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1')
scores = json.loads((root / 'scores-v1.json').read_text())
methods = ['parent'] + [f'{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000'
                        for arm in ['mse-control', 'charb-0p01', 'charb-0p003']
                        for endpoint in ['raw', 'EMA']]
metrics = {
    'mesh': ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'template_gain', 'blank_error_RMS_DN16',
             'blank_spatial_RMS_DN16', 'blank_DC_RMS_DN16', 'blank_added_RMS_DN16'],
    'photo': ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'crop_relative_band_error',
              'crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'],
    'flat': ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'full_spatial_RMS_DN16', 'block32_RMS_DN16',
             'crop_block32_RMS_DN16', 'worst_abs_DC_DN16'],
    'mixed-quiet': ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_error_RMS_DN16',
                    'quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_DC_RMS_DN16'],
}
groups = list(dict.fromkeys((s['kind'], s['condition'], s['cohort']) for s in scores['summary']))
result = []
for kind, condition, cohort in groups:
    if kind == 'real':
        continue
    rows = {s['method']: s for s in scores['summary']
            if (s['kind'], s['condition'], s['cohort']) == (kind, condition, cohort)}
    print(f'\n{kind} / {condition} / {cohort}; {rows["parent"]["cases"]} cases')
    for metric in metrics[kind]:
        if metric not in rows['parent']:
            continue
        values = {method: rows[method][metric] for method in methods}
        parent = values['parent']
        deltas = {method: (100 * (value / parent - 1) if parent else None)
                  for method, value in values.items()}
        print(metric, ' | '.join(f'{value:.8g}' for value in values.values()))
        print('  % vs V143', ' | '.join('n/a' if v is None else f'{v:+.5g}' for v in deltas.values()))
        result.append({'kind': kind, 'condition': condition, 'cohort': cohort,
                       'field': metric, 'cases': rows['parent']['cases'],
                       'values': values, 'percent_vs_parent': deltas})
print('\nMETHOD ORDER:', ', '.join(methods))
(root / 'human-metric-comparison-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')

"""Bind report tables to fixed final scores, without inference or endpoint selection."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1')
scores = json.loads((root / 'scores-v1.json').read_text())
methods = ['parent'] + [f'{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000' for arm in ['mse-control', 'charb-0p01', 'charb-0p003'] for endpoint in ['raw', 'EMA']]
labels = dict(zip(methods, ['V143', 'MSE raw', 'MSE EMA', 'Charb .01 raw', 'Charb .01 EMA', 'Charb .003 raw', 'Charb .003 EMA'], strict=True))
cells, lines = [], []
sections = {}

def group(kind, condition, cohort=None):
    return {s['method']: s for s in scores['summary']
            if (s['kind'], s['condition'], s['cohort']) == (kind, condition, cohort)}

def val(g, method, field, digits=6):
    item = g[method]
    text = f'{item[field]:.{digits}f}'
    cells.append({k: item[k] for k in ['kind', 'condition', 'cohort', 'method']} |
                 {'field': field, 'digits': digits, 'rendered': text})
    return text

def row(title, g, field, digits=6):
    line = '|' + title + '|' + '|'.join(val(g, method, field, digits) for method in methods) + '|'
    lines.append(line)
    return line + '\n'

def header(title):
    return '|' + title + '|' + '|'.join(labels[m] for m in methods) + '|\n| --- |' + ' ---: |' * len(methods) + '\n'

text = '| Method | Present full RMS | Response | Actual blank RMS | Blank spatial RMS | Added blank RMS |\n| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n'
for method in methods + ['periodic-detail']:
    line = '|' + labels.get(method, 'Existing periodic detail') + '|' + '|'.join(
        val(group('mesh', True), method, field, digits) for field, digits in [
            ('full_error_RMS_DN16', 6), ('template_gain', 8), ('blank_error_RMS_DN16', 6),
            ('blank_spatial_RMS_DN16', 6), ('blank_added_RMS_DN16', 8)]) + '|'
    lines.append(line)
    text += line + '\n'
sections['mesh'] = text
text = header('Flat test')
for title, g in [('Native512 ISO6400', group('flat', 'iso6400-prior', 'fresh-flat512')),
                 ('Native512 ISO12800', group('flat', 'iso12800-prior', 'fresh-flat512')),
                 ('Older native256 ISO12800', group('flat', 'iso12800-prior'))]:
    for suffix, field in [(' full RMS', 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), (' spatial RMS', 'full_spatial_RMS_DN16'), (' block32 RMS', 'block32_RMS_DN16')]:
        text += row(title + suffix, g, field)
sections['flat'] = text
text = header('Photo test')
for title, condition, cohort in [('Retained512 faint', 'photo-faint', 'retained512'), ('Retained512 dark', 'photo-dark', 'retained512'), ('Organic384 faint', 'photo-faint', 'organic384'), ('Organic384 dark', 'photo-dark', 'organic384')]:
    for suffix, field in [(' full RMS', 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), (' band error', 'crop_relative_band_error'), (' band response', 'crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain')]:
        text += row(title + suffix, group('photo', condition, cohort), field)
sections['photo'] = text
text = '| Prior | Method | Whole RMS | Quiet RMS | Quiet spatial RMS |\n| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |\n'
for condition, title in [('iso6400-prior', 'ISO6400'), ('iso12800-prior', 'ISO12800')]:
    g = group('mixed-quiet', condition)
    for method in methods:
        line = '|' + title + '|' + labels[method] + '|' + '|'.join(val(g, method, field) for field in ['full_error_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_error_RMS_DN16', 'quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16']) + '|'
        lines.append(line)
        text += line + '\n'
sections['quiet'] = text
text = header('ADC test')
adc, slopes = group('photo', 'adc-only', 'adc-photo256'), group('flat', 'adc-only', 'adc-sloped512')
for title, g, field in [('Photo full RMS', adc, 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), ('Photo band error', adc, 'crop_relative_band_error'), ('Photo band response', adc, 'crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'), ('Sloped512 full RMS', slopes, 'full_error_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 spatial RMS', slopes, 'full_spatial_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 block32 RMS', slopes, 'block32_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 crop block32 RMS', slopes, 'crop_block32_RMS_DN16'), ('Sloped512 worst absolute DC', slopes, 'worst_abs_DC_DN16')]:
    text += row(title, g, field)
sections['ADC'] = text
assert len(cells) == 285
(root / 'report-table-bindings-v1.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cells': cells, 'lines': lines, 'sections': sections}, indent=2) + '\n')
for title, text in sections.items():
    print(title + '\n' + text)
print('Bound numeric cells:', len(cells))

"""Record a human viewing event only after the assistant has actually seen it."""

import argparse
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('sheets', help='Comma-separated sheet numbers actually seen')
parser.add_argument('notes')
args = parser.parse_args()
root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1')
manifest = read(root / 'figures-v1.json')
journal = root / 'native-viewing-session-v1.jsonl'
events = [json.loads(line) for line in journal.read_text().splitlines()] if journal.exists() else []
seen = {number for event in events for number in event['sheets']}
selected = [int(number) for number in args.sheets.split(',')]
assert not seen.intersection(selected) and len(set(selected)) == len(selected)
assert all(0 <= number < len(manifest['sheets']) for number in selected)
for number in selected:
    sheet = manifest['sheets'][number]
    assert ref(sheet['image']['path']) == sheet['image'] and sheet['no_resize']
event = {'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(), 'sheets': selected,
         'detail': 'original', 'notes': args.notes}
with journal.open('a') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(event) + '\n')
events.append(event)
seen.update(selected)
print('Recorded actual viewing:', selected, '; total', len(seen))
if len(seen) == 21:
    assert seen == set(range(21)) and len(manifest['images']) == 84
    indices = [i for n in sorted(seen) for i in manifest['sheets'][n]['indices']]
    assert sorted(indices) == list(range(84)) and len(indices) == len(set(indices))
    save(root / 'native-viewing-v1.json', {
        'status': 'actually-viewed-all84-native-primary-figures-at-original-detail',
        'recorded_unix_UTC': time.time(), 'figure_manifest': ref(root / 'figures-v1.json'),
        'viewing_journal': ref(journal), 'events': events,
        'sheets_viewed': 21, 'primary_figures_covered': 84,
        'primary_indices_covered': sorted(indices), 'no_resize': True,
        'recorder': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
        'scope': 'All six fixed V154 raw/EMA endpoints,identical relative heads trained with delivered-RGB MSE or Charbonnier epsilon0.01/0.003. Actual original-detail viewing after image-tool outputs. Weak detail assessed beside actual blank/quiet errors,noisy-flat mottle,natural response,ADC photos/slopes and both standing real scenes/priors/windows/JPEGs. Real references qualitative,not exactGT.' })

"""Check actual terminal states for all twelve successful V154 owners."""

import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1')
training = read(root / 'status-v1.json')
post = read(root / 'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert training['status'] == 'completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review'
assert post['status'] == 'completed-audited-paired-arrays-awaiting-human-native-viewing'
assert set(post['completed']) == {'training-state-audit','checkpoint-validation','review','training-audit','scores','metric-audit','render'}
owners = [('training-controller', training['owner'])]
owners += [(name, read(root / f'{name}-result-v1.json')['owner']) for name in ['parity','smoke','train']]
owners += [('postprocess-controller', post['owner'])]
owners += [(stage, item['owner']) for stage, item in post['completed'].items()]
assert len(owners) == 12
records = []
for stage, owner in owners:
    try:
        p = psutil.Process(owner['pid'])
        terminal = 'PID-reused-original-terminal' if abs(p.create_time()-owner['created']) >= .01 else p.status()
        assert terminal in ['PID-reused-original-terminal','dead','zombie'], (stage,owner,terminal)
    except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
        terminal = 'absent'
    records.append({'stage':stage,'owner':owner,'terminal_state':terminal})
excluded = {os.getpid()} | {p.pid for p in psutil.Process().parents()}
matching = []
for p in psutil.process_iter(['pid','cmdline','status']):
    if p.pid in excluded or p.info['status'] in ['zombie','dead']:
        continue
    if any(t == str(root) or t.startswith(str(root)+'/') for t in p.info['cmdline'] or []):
        matching.append(p.info)
assert not matching, matching
save(root / 'execution-completion-v1.json', {
    'status':'all12-recorded-owners-terminal','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'recorded_owner_count':12,'owners':records,'live_matching_root_argv':matching,
    'training_completion':ref(root / 'status-v1.json'),
    'postprocess_completion':ref(root / 'postprocess-status-v1.json'),
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'Exact PID/create-time terminal checks for two controllers,three training workers and seven postprocess workers,including mandatory CPU checkpoint validation. Frozen controllers require zero child returns. No scientific failure or restart; root scan excludes verifier and ancestors.',
})
print('PASS: all12 recorded owners terminal; no live root argv matches')

"""Reduce archived support/proposal diagnostics without another model call."""

import math
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1')
cases = {c['id']: c for c in read(root / 'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']}
review = read(root / 'review-result-v1.json')
groups = []
checks = 0
for label, binding in review['collections'].items():
    assert ref(binding['path']) == binding
    collected = defaultdict(list)
    for observation in read(binding['path'])['observations']:
        case = cases[observation['id']]
        collected[case['kind'], case.get('present')].append(observation)
        if case['kind'] == 'mesh':
            collected['mesh-all', None].append(observation)
    for (kind, present), rows in collected.items():
        group = {'method': label, 'kind': kind, 'present': present, 'cases': len(rows)}
        for field in ['support_mean', 'coefficient_correction_RMS']:
            values = [row[field] for row in rows]
            assert all(math.isfinite(v) and v >= 0 for v in values)
            mean = math.fsum(values) / len(values)
            assert abs(mean - float(np.mean(np.array(values, dtype=np.float64)))) < 1e-15
            group[field] = mean
            group[field + '_minimum'] = min(values)
            group[field + '_maximum'] = max(values)
            checks += 1
        groups.append(group)
save(root / 'proposal-support-summary-v1.json', {
    'status': 'completed-archived-auxiliary-reductions',
    'review': ref(root / 'review-result-v1.json'),
    'source': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'groups': groups, 'independent_mean_checks': checks,
    'new_forwards': 0, 'new_noise_draws': 0,
    'scope': 'Unweighted means of archived per-observation spatial support means and pre-support coefficient-correction RMS. NumPy64 means independently agree with math.fsum. Mean support is not calibrated detection or evidence of spatial selectivity. Coefficient RMS is not final RGB error or a hallucination metric.'})
for row in groups:
    if row['kind'] in ['mesh-all', 'mesh']:
        print(row['method'], row['kind'], row['present'], row['support_mean'], row['coefficient_correction_RMS'])

"""Summarize recorded pre-clip norms; no additional training or forward calls."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1')
plan = read(root / 'plan-v1.json')
cache = read(plan['cache']['path'])
training = read(root / 'train-result-v1.json')
groups = []
for arm in training['counts']:
    for adc in [True, False]:
        rows = [r['arms'][arm] for r, b in zip(training['trace'], cache['batches'], strict=True)
                if (b['metadata']['noise']['shot'] == b['metadata']['noise']['read'] == 0) == adc]
        norms = np.array([r['gradient_norm'] for r in rows], dtype=np.float64)
        groups.append({'arm': arm, 'ADC_only': adc, 'batches': len(rows),
                       'norm_median': float(np.median(norms)),
                       'norm_maximum': float(norms.max()),
                       'norms_over_one': int((norms > 1).sum()),
                       'sum_norm_capped_at_one_squared_proxy': float((np.minimum(norms, 1)**2).sum()),
                       'exact_zero_norms': int((norms == 0).sum()),
                       'exact_zero_total_losses': sum(r['loss'] == 0 for r in rows)})
save(root / 'training-routing-summary-v1.json', {
    'status': 'completed-recorded-trace-reduction',
    'training': ref(root / 'train-result-v1.json'), 'cache': plan['cache'],
    'source': dict(ref(Path(__file__)), text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'groups': groups, 'new_forwards': 0, 'new_noise_draws': 0,
    'scope': 'Recorded pre-clipping full-parameter gradient norms. Capping at one omits clipping epsilon; summed squared norms are a routing proxy, not Adam displacement, influence, or a causal quality result. Zero gradients retain optimizer/EMA coasting.'})
for row in groups:
    print(row)

"""Add native noisy-flat triplets from already independently checked V154 boards."""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

root = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261103/V154-robust-spectral-v1')
figures = read(root / 'figures-v1.json')
out = root / 'flat-triplets-v1'
assert not out.exists()
out.mkdir()
font = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 10)
records = []
channels = 0
for prior in ['iso6400', 'iso12800']:
    boards = [b for b in figures['images'] if b['case']['id'] == f'flat512-gray-l0.02-{prior}-prior-RGGB' and 'triplet_source_board' not in b]
    assert len(boards) == 1
    board = boards[0]
    assert ref(board['image']['path']) == board['image']
    before = np.asarray(Image.open(board['image']['path']))
    assert board['ROI_xywh'] == [176,176,160,160] and board['contrast'] == 40 and board['exposure'] == 4
    for i, (method, checkpoint) in enumerate(figures['checkpoints'].items()):
        panels = [board['panels'][0], board['panels'][i+2], board['panels'][-1]]
        triplet = Image.new('RGB', (512,212), '#eeeeee')
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(triplet)
        draw.text((8,4), f'{prior} gray .02 RGGB | contrast40, RAW exposure4 | native160px', font=font, fill='black')
        positions = []
        for j, p in enumerate(panels):
            x,y,w,h = p['xywh']
            assert w == h == 160
            cell = before[y:y+h,x:x+w]
            xywh = [8+j*168,44,160,160]
            triplet.paste(Image.fromarray(cell), xywh[:2])
            draw.text((xywh[0],24), p['label'], font=font, fill='black')
            positions.append({'label':p['label'], 'xywh':xywh, 'source_xywh':p['xywh']})
            channels += cell.size
        dest = out / f'flat-{prior}-{method}-triplet.png'
        triplet.save(dest)
        after = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
        for p in positions:
            x,y,w,h=p['xywh'];sx,sy,sw,sh=p['source_xywh']
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(after[y:y+h,x:x+w],before[sy:sy+sh,sx:sx+sw])
        records.append({k:board[k] for k in ['case','ROI_xywh','anchor','contrast','exposure','no_resize','JPEG_display']} |
                       {'image':ref(dest), 'panels':positions, 'triplet_source_board':board['image'],
                        'method':method,'checkpoint':checkpoint})
assert len(records) == 12 and channels == 2764800
sheets=[]
for start in range(0,12,4):
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(512,848),'white')
    indices=list(range(start,start+4))
    for j,i in enumerate(indices):
        sheet.paste(Image.open(records[i]['image']['path']),(0,j*212))
    path=out / f'sheet-{start//4:02d}.png'
    sheet.save(path)
    pixels=np.asarray(Image.open(path))
    for j,i in enumerate(indices):
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(pixels[j*212:(j+1)*212],np.asarray(Image.open(records[i]['image']['path'])))
    sheets.append({'image':ref(path),'indices':indices,'no_resize':True})
save(root/'flat-triplets-v1.json', {
    'status':'pass-all12-native-flat-triplets-equal-source-board-cells',
    'source_manifest':ref(root/'figures-v1.json'),'renderer':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'images':records,'sheets':sheets,'triplets':12,'independently_checked_RGB_channels':channels,
    'no_resize':True,'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Same preexisting native512 dark-gray ISO6400/12800 boards,ROI176,176,160,160,all six fixed endpoints. Three native160px cells,noisy Malvar/restored/exact constructed GT. Same camera-space contrast40 around exact target mean,RAW exposure4 then display conversion. Small standalone-flat gain with persistent mottle; no general flat-safety claim. Actual viewing follows separately.'})
print('PASS:12 native flat triplets;2,764,800 RGB channels;3 unscaled sheets')
